title: Vampire Vape White Chocolate Hazelnut Tobacco 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape White Chocolate Hazelnut Tobacco Shortfill combines earthy Tobacco with creamy White Chocolate and roasted Hazelnut for a distinctive vape. The Tobacco provides body and depth, while sweet White Chocolate and nutty Hazelnut add indulgent accents that transform the blend into something unique. With a 70VG/30PG mix, this 100ml shortfill is tailored for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping on sub-ohm devices, producing dense vapour and rounded flavour. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, leaving space to add two 10ml nicotine shots. Made in the UK, Vampire Vape are known for their bold blends and consistent quality. Their Tobacco range highlights innovative takes on classic profiles.
